items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: Well at the time we started with the bass player, Henry Bocci, Peter Bocci, Charlie Bocci, Lillian Warner, myself, and Alfred Williams, six pieces.

ctx.x: Piano. Adolf and the guy just called, he was a piano player. Dwight Newman? Dwight Newman, yeah, he died. And Adolf died too. But he had Louie Warner playing sax, and Pete was playing trumpet, and his brothers playing guitar, and Williams. Yeah, drumming.
